styles.name: Cinematic photoreal
styles.prefix: cinematic photorealistic film still, shot on a full-frame cinema camera with a 35mm lens, natural motivated lighting, shallow depth of field, rich true-to-life colors, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, crisp fine detail
styles.avoid: cartoon, illustration, oversaturated colors, plastic-looking skin, distorted hands or faces

styles.name: Moody cinematic
styles.prefix: moody cinematic film still, low-key lighting with deep shadows, teal and amber color grade, anamorphic lens with soft flares, atmospheric haze, dramatic composition, rich contrast
styles.avoid: flat lighting, bright cheerful colors, cartoon look, blown-out highlights

styles.name: Documentary
styles.prefix: documentary photograph for a nature and travel magazine, available light, candid unposed moment, authentic textures, natural colors, sharp focus, environmental storytelling, 50mm lens
styles.avoid: staged studio look, heavy filters, fantasy elements, cartoon style

styles.name: Warm lifestyle
styles.prefix: warm lifestyle photograph, soft window light, airy and bright, gentle warm pastel tones, cozy natural materials like linen and wood, shallow depth of field, inviting and calm atmosphere
styles.avoid: harsh shadows, neon colors, gloomy mood, cluttered backgrounds

styles.name: 3D animated film
styles.prefix: stylized 3D animated film still, soft global illumination, appealing rounded character design with expressive faces, vibrant harmonious colors, subsurface scattering on skin, cinematic depth of field, polished family-film quality
styles.avoid: photorealism, live action, creepy uncanny faces, copyrighted characters

styles.name: Anime-inspired
styles.prefix: anime-inspired illustration, clean cel shading, crisp confident line art, luminous painted sky, vibrant saturated palette, dramatic rim lighting, richly detailed background art
styles.avoid: photorealism, 3D render look, muddy colors, copyrighted characters

styles.name: Graphic novel
styles.best: Rivalries, history, action, explainers with attitude
styles.prefix: graphic novel panel, bold ink outlines, halftone shading, dramatic camera angles, limited bold palette with strong blacks and one spot color, dynamic composition, hand-inked texture
styles.avoid: photorealism, soft gradients, speech bubbles, lettering

styles.name: Watercolor storybook
styles.prefix: loose watercolor storybook illustration on cold-press paper, soft bleeding edges, granulating pigments, delicate hand-drawn pencil lines, gentle muted palette, white paper showing through
styles.avoid: photorealism, hard digital edges, neon colors, heavy black outlines

styles.name: Clean explainer
styles.prefix: clean flat vector illustration for an explainer video, simple geometric shapes, generous negative space, a calm palette of navy, sky blue and off-white with one golden accent, subtle long shadows, modern and tidy
styles.avoid: photorealism, clutter, tiny details, written labels

styles.name: Retro 80s
styles.prefix: 1980s retro aesthetic, VHS camcorder look, neon magenta and cyan lighting, synthwave sunset colors, soft bloom, slight chromatic aberration and scanlines, nostalgic analog grain
styles.avoid: modern minimal look, muted earthy colors, clean digital sharpness

styles.name: Paper cut-out
styles.prefix: layered paper cut-out diorama, handcrafted colored paper with visible fibers, soft drop shadows between layers, playful stop-motion craft feel, warm cheerful craft palette, shot from the front with gentle studio light
styles.avoid: photorealistic people, glossy plastic, digital gradients

styles.name: Minimal line art
styles.prefix: minimal continuous line art, single-weight black ink lines on a warm off-white background, one muted terracotta accent color, lots of empty space, elegant and simple composition
styles.avoid: shading, busy backgrounds, many colors, photorealism
